migration_scope: Agent runtime and demo wiring only. Validated firewall v0.3 and broker v0.3.1 unchanged.
resolver_semantics: Runtime accepts an optional external live authority resolver. When supplied, the validated firewall queries it after PRE_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED at the consequence boundary. Without an external resolver, the runtime supplies its latest locally established execution authority.
pass_criterion: Deterministic model is invoked under valid standing; authority changes after PRE_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED; boundary resolver returns changed authority; firewall refuses before consequence; outbox remains unchanged; witness chain verifies.
nonclaim: No distributed revocation-propagation, absolute atomicity, or unbounded concurrency claim.
